/.title: Gerald Tesha · My Strava Journey · Seven years on foot
/.description: Gerald Tesha's seven years on foot, mostly in Tanzania: 2,068 outings and 13,255 km from his Strava log, with maps, records, tested habits and a free book.

/numbers.title: Year in Sport
/numbers.description: Every year of my log as its own report, from 27 outings in 2019 to 330 in 2026 so far.

/sports.title: Sports
/sports.description: My four sports on foot: 9,132 km of running and 4,012 km of walking, with trail runs and hikes, and the treadmill kept apart from the road.

/records.title: Records
/records.description: My longest, highest and hardest days on foot: 42.7 km in one outing, 1,979 m of climbing in one outing, and 308 days in a row.

/where.title: Where
/where.description: Where I go out: five African countries and 17 regions of Tanzania, mapped from where each outing started.

/timeline.title: Timeline
/timeline.description: Seven years in the order they happened: milestones, firsts on foot, trips, streaks and breaks.

/goals.title: Goals
/goals.description: The same three targets held against every year: 1,000 km of walking, 1,000 km of running and 24,000 m of climbing on foot.

/what-it-means.title: What It Means
/what-it-means.description: What seven years of logging taught me about keeping a habit, in my own words, with the numbers behind each lesson.

/on-trial.title: The Habit on Trial
/on-trial.description: Twelve things I believe about my habit, tested with statistics against the log: seven proven, three supported and two not proven.

/book.title: My Book
/book.description: Showing Up, the whole story as a free book, with every chart drawn from the log up to 1 November 2026. Read it online or download the PDF.

/about.title: About
/about.description: How this site was made, what the data covers and how to reach me.

/data.title: The Data
/data.description: Every table behind the site, what it holds and where it comes from.
